subject: Question about my receipt from the Nanshan store
body:
Hi there,

I stopped by the Shenzhen Nanshan store last weekend and picked up a jar of face cream. The staff member who helped me was genuinely lovely — she took the time to walk me through the different options and didn't rush me at all, which I appreciated.

When I looked at my receipt afterwards, though, I noticed a line for a service charge that I hadn't expected. It's not a huge amount, but I honestly don't remember anyone mentioning it at the counter, so I wanted to ask what it's for. Was it something I agreed to without realizing?

I'm not trying to make a fuss — the cream itself has been great so far — I'd just like to understand the charge before I come back.

Thanks,
Jamie
